description: List the source databases aggregated by World Bank Data360 (e.g. WB_WDI = World Development Indicators, IMF_BOP = Balance of Payments, WB_EDSTATS = Education Statistics). Returns each DATABASE_ID with its full name and indicator count. Use a DATABASE_ID here to scope data360_search_indicators and data360_get_data.

top.description: Max databases to return (default 200, the full list).

name: data360_list_databases
title: Data360 List Databases
